title: Dragonmaw Retreat loot
wikitext:
This page lists the loot found on bosses in the [[Dragonmaw Retreat]].

==Shard of the Demon Soul==
[[Zuluhed the Whacked]] drops the [[Shard of the Demon Soul]], which like most other end-bosses starts a reward quest for killing the last boss of an instance. Turning in the shard allows players to choose from the following rewards:
{{itembox|[[Shard of the Demon Soul]] Rewards|Pendant of Ember Blood|Pendant of Ember Blessing|Pendant of Ember Hatred}}
